text:
leo: Kicking off a small canary for shape-aware embed routing + "soft-quota" advisory headers in ~30m. want quick feedback loop from console and oncall.
anika: Nice. TL;DR of the flow? keep it short.
matt: We should include an example header and what clients will see.
leo: Flow bullets: 1) ingress tries `X-Redwood-Embed-Dim` header; if absent sample first 8 vectors (probe) 2) compute p50/p95 dims and label `dim_profile=narrow|normal|wide` 3) routing: fastpath for narrow/normal, chunk-split for wide, or small-model fallback if payload too big 4) emit metrics + structured event for later analysis 5) soft-quota: send advisory header instead of immediate 413 for initial violations during canary.
julia: what's the advisory header? and how will console surface it?
leo: header: `X-Redwood-Embed-Advice: suggested-delay=80ms; reason=wide_shape`  Console will show per-tenant advice_ratio sparkline + a heatmap of dim distributions (p50/p95/unique).
dylan: perf notes from bench: sampling 8 vectors adds ~0.25ms on p95 for ingress path. Decision heuristics: p50>1024 or p95>3072 -> wide. These thresholds are configurable flags. Batching unaffected.
deploy-bot: deploy plan: canary=5% traffic for 2h. monitor metrics: `embed.dim_profile.count`, `embed.route.fastpath_rate`, `embed.advice.sent`, `embed.hard_413.count`. auto-rollback if per-tenant `embed.hard_413.count` > 0 within a 10m window.
sre-oncall: please tag alerts to #eng-oncall. would like a temporary runbook step to disable advice if we see client regressions.
anika: Quota semantics: proposal: soft-quota = advisory tier backed by a token-bucket per-tenant. if clients repeatedly ignore advice (N events), escalate to hard 413. also track `embed.quota.advice_ignored` metric.
matt: Implementation suggestion: store token-bucket in redis with TTL and emit `embed.quota.tokens` gauge. increment `embed.advice.sent` only when token count < threshold.
dylan: For routing fallback, add `embed.routing.fallback_counter` when we hit small-model or lower-capacity path so product can understand quality regressions.
deploy-bot: ops rules: if `embed.hard_413.count` > 0.1% of canary traffic overall, rollback. Also alert if `embed.advice.sent` > 5% and `embed.advice.honored_rate` < 10% for same tenant.
console-bot: UI tasks queued: (1) heatmap tile of tenant vs dim-range (p50/p95), (2) advice-rate sparkline, (3) drilldown: sample requests + headers, (4) toggle controls: enable-advice, force-hard-limit, sample-tenant opt-in. aiming for prototype EOD tomorrow.
julia: tests: unit for probe correctness, integration test that simulates mixed-dim traffic and asserts no p50 regression for narrow traffic, e2e verifying advisory header emitted.
leo: sample curl to add to changelog / docs:

curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Embed-Dim: 4096" \
  -d '{"inputs": [[...],[...]]}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings

Response headers may include e.g. `X-Redwood-Embed-Advice: suggested-delay=100ms;reason=wide_shape` or `X-Redwood-Embed-Route: chunk_splitter` or `X-Redwood-Embed-Route: fastpath`.
matt: docs item: short blurb + migration tips (how to send header, retry/backoff suggestions).
dylan: I'll add a k8s loadtest scenario: two tenants, one with 95% narrow dims, another with 40% wide dims. measure `embed.route.fastpath_rate` and `embed.hard_413.count` for 1h.
sre-oncall: good. add alert: if `embed.hard_413.count` spikes for any tenant -> immediate pager.
anika: telemetry backends: emit prom metrics plus a structured event `embed.dim_profile_event` to event-shipper with tags: tenant_id, dim_profile, route, advice_sent, probe_used. Product wants bigquery slices.
console-bot: noted - events will be shippped and we will surface tenant drilldowns.
leo: small note: header is optional but recommended. if header disagrees with probe we record `dim_header_mismatch` in events. clients who persistently misreport will get more advice headers.
matt: rollout UX: for the 3 initial opt-in tenants we should enable a live console pane showing the canary telemetry and a button to revoke opt-in.
deploy-bot: starting canary in 30m. will post updates in this thread and ping #eng-oncall.
leo: thanks all — will iterate on thresholds after first 2h. :rocket:
